description:
Title: Service for Your Fridge

Your fridge produces strange noises.
You describe the symptoms, and send them together with the type of fridge to the central fridge service center.
They select a local service facility (which all have their own way of interacting with customers).
The service facility makes an appointment.
They arrive at a random time, and sometimes have to leave without repairing your fridge, because they need additional parts.
After your fridge is repaired, you have to confirm that it is OK again.
You can rate the service facility.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"

                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/fridge-service">

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Symptoms" name="Symptoms and fridge type"/>

  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Appointment" name="Appointment"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_FridgeService">

    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Facility" name="Local Service Facility" processRef="Process_Facility"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Symptoms" name="Send symptoms and fridge type"
                      sourceRef="Send_Symptoms" targetRef="Start_Center_Request"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Request" name="Forward service request"
                      sourceRef="Send_Request_Facility" targetRef="Start_Facility_Request"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Appointment" name="Appointment offered"
                      sourceRef="Send_Appointment" targetRef="Receive_Appointment"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_RepairDone" name="Repair completed"
                      sourceRef="Send_Repair_Done" targetRef="Catch_Repair_Done"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_Symptoms" name="Send symptoms and fridge type" messageRef="Msg_Symptoms"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Receive_Appointment" name="Receive appointment" messageRef="Msg_Appointment"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Repair_Done" name="Repair completed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Repair_Done" messageRef="Msg_RepairDone"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Confirm_Repair" name="Confirm fridge is working again"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Rate_Decision" name="Rate service facility?" default="CF_C12"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Rate_Facility" name="Rate service facility"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Customer" name="Service completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_C1" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Gateway_Gather_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_C2" sourceRef="Gateway_Gather_Split" targetRef="Task_Describe_Symptoms"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_C3" sourceRef="Gateway_Gather_Split" targetRef="Task_Provide_Fridge_Type"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_C4" sourceRef="Task_Describe_Symptoms" targetRef="Gateway_Gather_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_C5" sourceRef="Task_Provide_Fridge_Type" targetRef="Gateway_Gather_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_C6" sourceRef="Gateway_Gather_Join" targetRef="Send_Symptoms"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_C7" sourceRef="Send_Symptoms" targetRef="Receive_Appointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_C8" sourceRef="Receive_Appointment" targetRef="Catch_Repair_Done"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_C9" sourceRef="Catch_Repair_Done" targetRef="Task_Confirm_Repair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_C10" sourceRef="Task_Confirm_Repair" targetRef="Gateway_Rate_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_C11" name="Rate" sourceRef="Gateway_Rate_Decision" targetRef="Task_Rate_Facility"/>

  <!-- Central service center -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Center" name="Central Fridge Service Center" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Center_Request" name="Service request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Center_Request" messageRef="Msg_Symptoms"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Select_Facility" name="Select local service facility"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_Request_Facility" name="Forward request to facility" messageRef="Msg_Request"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Center" name="Request forwarded"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_D1" sourceRef="Start_Center_Request" targetRef="Task_Select_Facility"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_D2" sourceRef="Task_Select_Facility" targetRef="Send_Request_Facility"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_D3" sourceRef="Send_Request_Facility" targetRef="End_Center"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <!-- Local service facility -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Facility" name="Local Service Facility" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Facility_Request" name="Service request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Facility_Request" messageRef="Msg_Request"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Make_Appointment" name="Make appointment"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Arrival" name="Facility arrives at random time"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Repair_Split" name="Repair possible?" default="CF_F10"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_Repair_Fridge" name="Repair fridge"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_Repair_Done" name="Notify customer of completed repair" messageRef="Msg_RepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Repaired" name="Fridge repaired"/>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_Leave_Without_Repair" name="Leave without repairing"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_F1" sourceRef="Start_Facility_Request" targetRef="Task_Make_Appointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_F2" sourceRef="Task_Make_Appointment" targetRef="Send_Appointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_F3" sourceRef="Send_Appointment" targetRef="Gateway_Arrival_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_F4" sourceRef="Gateway_Arrival_Merge" targetRef="Catch_Arrival"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_F5" sourceRef="Catch_Arrival" targetRef="Task_Visit_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_F6" sourceRef="Task_Visit_Customer" targetRef="Gateway_Repair_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_F7" name="Repaired" sourceRef="Gateway_Repair_Split" targetRef="Task_Repair_Fridge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_F8" sourceRef="Task_Repair_Fridge" targetRef="Send_Repair_Done"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_F9" sourceRef="Send_Repair_Done" targetRef="End_Repaired"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_F10" name="Parts needed" sourceRef="Gateway_Repair_Split" targetRef="Task_Leave_Without_Repair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CF_F11" sourceRef="Task_Leave_Without_Repair" targetRef="Gateway_Arrival_Merge"/>
  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>
